security_audit.summary: Markdown backticks, public Ministry of Education URLs, and readable multilingual text explain eleven findings without evidence of malicious execution, exfiltration, or obfuscation. Three filesystem findings concern predictable shared temporary paths, enabling local overwrite or dataset tampering when another process can control those paths. No evidence found of prompt injection or credential collection.

remediation.issue: Downloads write to predictable shared paths that can overwrite existing files or follow attacker-created symbolic links.
remediation.suggestion: Create a private temporary directory with mktemp -d or tempfile.TemporaryDirectory, then download and read datasets inside it.

remediation.issue: The CSV parser trusts a predictable shared file without checking its origin or schema.
remediation.suggestion: Keep download and parsing within the same private directory; check HTTP success, expected headers, and numeric fields before reporting totals.

content.user_title: Find Taiwan Schools and Enrollment Statistics
content.value_statement: School directories and enrollment figures are difficult to compare across academic years. This skill guides public dataset retrieval, school filtering, and year-specific reporting.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve public Ministry of Education CSV datasets for Taiwan elementary and junior high schools without authentication.
Guide filtering by county, school name, and district where that field exists.
Identify schools using Ministry of Education school codes.
Calculate elementary class totals from columns 6 through 11 and student totals from columns 12 through 23.
Parse UTF-8 BOM CSV files with Python and distinguish annual elementary files from the multi-year junior high file.
Report the academic year and explain its calendar-year period.
limitations: High school, vocational school, and university datasets are not covered.
Published statistics do not provide live enrollment, admission availability, or individual student records.
The documented datasets cover years through 114; newer availability and changed column layouts require verification.
Retrieval requires network access and local command tools; junior high records do not document a district column.

use_cases.title: Compare Local Schools
use_cases.description: Find elementary schools in a selected district and compare their published class and student totals for one academic year.

use_cases.title: Analyze Small Schools
use_cases.description: Filter elementary schools by county and student threshold to identify small schools in the selected annual dataset.

use_cases.title: Match School Records
use_cases.description: Retrieve school codes and academic-year statistics to support matching with another dataset that uses Ministry of Education codes.

prompt_templates.title: Find a School
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the elementary division of Tamkang High School in Tamsui for academic year 114. Report its school code, county, and district.

prompt_templates.title: Compare District Enrollment
prompt_templates.prompt: List elementary schools in [county] and [district] for academic year [year]. Include school codes, total classes, total students, and the dataset source.

prompt_templates.title: Identify Small Schools
prompt_templates.prompt: Find elementary schools in [county] with fewer than [threshold] students for academic year [year]. Sort by enrollment and explain the summed columns.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Junior High Years
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare junior high enrollment in [county] for academic years [year A] and [year B]. Match school codes and flag missing records.

output_examples.input: Identify the elementary division of Tamkang High School in the documented year 114 example.
output: School: Elementary division of private Tamkang High School.
Location: Tamsui District, New Taipei City.
Academic year: 114, covering August 2025 through July 2026.
The documented example reports two to three classes per grade across grades one through six.

output_examples.input: Explain how to calculate elementary school totals for academic year 114.
output: Use the annual elementary dataset for academic year 114.
Add columns 6 through 11 for total classes across grades one through six.
Add columns 12 through 23 for total students, including both sex-specific columns for each grade.
Report the school name, district, totals, and academic year.
Academic year 114 runs from August 2025 through July 2026.

best_practices: Specify the school level, location, and academic year before retrieving data.
Verify column headers and filter junior high rows to the requested academic year before calculating totals.
Download into a private temporary directory and cite the dataset source and academic-year period in each report.
anti_patterns: Do not interpret an academic-year number as a calendar year.
Do not combine junior high records from different academic years into one enrollment total.
Do not treat published aggregate statistics as live admission availability or individual student information.

faq.question: Which schools are covered?
faq.answer: The documented workflow covers Taiwan elementary and junior high schools. High schools, vocational schools, and universities require different datasets.

faq.question: Do I need an API key or account?
faq.answer: No API key or login is required for the documented public datasets. Network access is required.

faq.question: What does academic year 114 mean?
faq.answer: Academic year 114 covers August 2025 through July 2026. It is not calendar year 2025 alone.

faq.question: Are the enrollment numbers current?
faq.answer: These are published academic-year statistics, not live enrollment figures. The skill documents datasets through year 114 and a September 2026 test.

faq.question: Can I filter schools by district?
faq.answer: The elementary dataset includes a district field. The documented junior high fields include county information but not a district column.

faq.question: How should I handle download failures?
faq.answer: Retry with the documented browser user agent. If retrieval still fails, report the source problem rather than inventing school statistics.
